title: TransactionCreateRequest
description: Body of POST /api/transactions. The server assigns the Id; the client never supplies one. The shape is immutable on the client side once constructed.

timestamp.description: Naive local datetime, second precision. Example: '2026-05-07T09:15:00'.

description.description: Required free-text description. Validation enforcement (non-empty) is a downstream concern; the contract permits any string here.

amount.description: Positive monetary amount in USD. Direction is conveyed by transactionType, not by sign on this field.

categoryIds.description: Non-empty ordered list of category ids the transaction is tagged with. Duplicates are permitted at the contract level; dedup/compat checks happen downstream.
